sources.title: 119th Congressional District to 2020 county subdivision relationship file (Wisconsin)
sources.apa: U.S. Census Bureau. (2024). 119th Congressional District to 2020 county subdivision relationship file (Wisconsin) [Data set]. Retrieved November 24, 2026, from https://www.census.gov/geographies/reference-files/time-series/geo/relationship-files.2020.html

data.note: A municipality that crosses a county line is listed once in each county. Status is by share of land area as of the 2020 Census; the file has no population by part.
